meta.title: Products
meta.description: Innovative solutions in travel technology: Aggregator, AirviaGo Charter, API, Agent (B2B), E-Commerce (B2C), APP and Enterprise.

hero.title: One platform. Seven ways to sell the sky.
hero.text: AirviaTech offers cutting-edge and comprehensive solutions for travel agencies, tour operators, corporate clients and individual travelers. With advanced technology, flexible integration options and a user-centric approach, we optimize the travel experience for maximum efficiency.

closing.title: Step into the future of travel technology
closing.text: With our innovative and scalable solutions, transform the travel industry and elevate your business. Discover AirviaTech products for tailored solutions that fit your business needs.

items.name: AirviaTech Aggregator
items.headline: The future of airline ticketing & content distribution
items.subheadline: Unmatched airline connectivity & smart fare management
intro: AirviaTech Aggregator is a next-generation airline ticketing and content distribution platform that empowers travel agencies, tour operators and online travel businesses with seamless access to a vast network of global airlines.

With real-time integration to {{airlines}} airlines, including both full-service and low-cost carriers, our platform ensures you get the most competitive fares, dynamic pricing and extensive travel options at your fingertips.

items.title: Multi-GDS & NDC support
items.text: Direct connectivity with multiple GDSs and NDC airline systems for exclusive airline fares. Manage multiple IATA and agency accounts in one centralized system — fully compliant with IATA NDC standards for the richest content and ancillaries.

items.title: Dynamic pricing & smart fare optimization
items.text: AI-powered dynamic pricing models, integration with negotiated, published and corporate fares, and real-time fare comparison across providers so you always get the best deal.

items.title: Advanced search & booking
items.text: Multi-city, one-way and round-trip itineraries, real-time availability with instant confirmation, and comprehensive seat selection and cabin class options.

items.title: Custom API & white-label
items.text: Powerful API integrations for existing systems, fully branded B2B and B2C white-label platforms, and custom markups, commissions and discounts per market segment.

items.title: Robust reporting & analytics
items.text: Real-time dashboards for sales, booking trends and revenue, customizable reports, and AI-driven market insights and fare predictions.

sections.title: Seamless airline content & ancillary services
sections.intro: AirviaTech Aggregator doesn't stop at ticketing — it lets travel businesses offer additional services that enhance the journey:

items.text: Baggage allowance purchases & paid seat selection
Priority boarding & lounge access
Onboard meals & in-flight entertainment
Flexible cancellation & refund policies
Special fares for corporate, student and military travelers

items.title: Travel agencies & OTAs
items.text: Simplify airline bookings, maximize revenues and scale globally.

items.title: Tour operators
items.text: Seamlessly bundle flights with vacation packages.

items.title: Corporate travel managers
items.text: Access the best business travel deals with real-time insights.

items.title: Airlines & consolidators
items.text: Expand distribution and optimize pricing for diverse markets.
Faster response times & real-time availability
Seamless multi-GDS and direct airline integrations
AI-powered pricing intelligence for competitive fares
Easy-to-use platform with intuitive UI/UX
Comprehensive support & dedicated account management

closing.title: Revolutionize your flight booking operations
closing.text: With AirviaTech Aggregator, travel businesses gain unparalleled access to global airline inventory, enhanced pricing strategies and superior booking capabilities — all through a single, powerful platform.

items.name: AirviaGo Charter
items.headline: Charter & block seat provider management and operations software
items.subheadline: The new era in charter flight management

From flight planning to ticketing, AirviaGo Charter digitalizes the entire process to make charter operations more efficient and profitable.

sections.title: Features & benefits
sections.intro: Maximize efficiency, minimize hassle — AirviaGo Charter simplifies your charter operations.

items.title: Flight & inventory management
items.text: Integrate your aircraft and inventory. Schedule flights for specific destinations on different dates, defining seat classes, quantities and pricing.

items.title: Bulk data upload
items.text: Save time by importing your flight details from an Excel file in one go.

items.title: Extensive sales network
items.text: Sell directly to sub-agents through API integration and the AirviaTech Agent system.

items.title: Reservation & ticketing management
items.text: Easily manage incoming ticketing and reservation requests through the AirviaGo panel.

items.title: Seat & capacity tracking
items.text: Monitor available seats in real time, manage reservations and enhance operational efficiency.

items.title: Flexible operations
items.text: Handle changes, cancellations and refund requests effortlessly, improving customer satisfaction.

items.title: Reporting & analytics
items.text: Track sales performance and operational data with advanced reporting tools.

items.title: Sales channel management
items.text: Define different sales channels and control the entire process from a centralized panel.

sections.title: Why choose AirviaGo Charter?
sections.intro: Real-time data means real-time control — optimize your capacity like never before.

items.text: Easy to use and quick integration
End-to-end digitalized charter operation management
API and agent sales network integration

closing.title: Digitize and strengthen your charter operations

items.name: AirviaTech Agent
items.headline: Powerful B2B travel solutions
items.subheadline: Integrated, flexible and profitable tools for travel agencies
intro: AirviaTech Agent is a next-generation B2B booking platform designed specifically for travel agencies and OTAs.
It consolidates all travel products under one roof, helping you grow your sales network and manage operations effortlessly.

items.text: Manage all flight booking processes through a single interface connected to global GDS systems, LCCs, NDC connections and third-party XML/API integrations.
Offer a complete travel experience with a rich module structure that includes flights, hotels, car rentals, transfers, visas and tour packages.

items.title: Custom access & pricing
items.text: Define separate permissions and pricing policies for each sub-agent.

items.title: Multi-level distribution
items.text: Build a dynamic sales structure with a full agent hierarchy.

items.title: Real-time tracking
items.text: Monitor and manage every booking and status instantly.
Connect directly with IATA, charter operators, block seat providers and your contracted airlines via AirviaTech Agent.
Your agencies gain first-hand access to AirviaGo's exclusive seat inventory and the most competitive market fares.

items.name: AirviaTech E-Commerce
items.headline: Smart and effective B2C travel solutions
items.subheadline: Deliver a seamless online booking experience to your customers
intro: AirviaTech E-Commerce is a powerful B2C sales platform developed for travel brands aiming to reach individual end-users.
With its modern, mobile-responsive and intuitive interface, it makes the booking process fast, simple and secure for your customers.

items.title: User-friendly interface
items.text: Boost conversion with a clean, intuitive, fully mobile-compatible booking interface. Users find what they need and complete their booking in a single step.

items.title: Multi-language & multi-currency
items.text: Expand internationally with multi-language options, localized pricing with dynamic currency support, and regional campaign and content management.

items.title: Fast & secure transactions
items.text: Real-time pricing and availability, SSL-protected payment systems, instant confirmation and a streamlined journey with minimal steps.

items.title: Rich content & product management
items.text: Dynamic supplier content, images, descriptions and destination info, plus combinations like tour packages or flight + hotel bundles.
AirviaTech E-Commerce works seamlessly with major travel content sources including NDC, GDS and LCCs.
While robust travel technology powers the backend, you can focus entirely on optimizing the customer experience.

closing.title: Get one step closer to your customers
closing.text: Digitize your brand, connect directly with your audience and boost your sales. Make a difference in your B2C sales channel with AirviaTech E-Commerce.

items.name: AirviaTech Enterprise
items.headline: Next-generation corporate travel management
items.subheadline: Smart travel solutions for smart companies
intro: AirviaTech Enterprise is a powerful sales and management platform designed to help travel agencies provide tailored services to their corporate clients.

Its flexible structure offers both travel managers and employees a fully compliant reservation experience aligned with corporate policies and workflows — unifying efficiency, control and cost advantages in a single platform.

sections.title: Setting the new standard in corporate travel
sections.intro: Multiple locations, dozens of employees, tight schedules and strict budgets — AirviaTech Enterprise simplifies this complexity with centralized management:

items.text: Manage flights, hotels and transfers from a single platform
Create customizable booking workflows aligned with company policies
Full control with role-based access, approval hierarchies and advanced security

items.title: Policy compliance & approvals
items.text: The system enforces company travel policies, filters results accordingly and automates approvals — with multi-level flows and instant notifications for high-budget trips.

items.title: Advanced search & booking
items.text: Detailed search filters and a fast booking flow so travelers find compliant options in seconds.

items.title: Integrated payment & expenses
items.text: Corporate cards, department budgets or employee cards; automatic expense recording and post-trip reimbursement workflows.

items.title: Itineraries & notifications
items.text: Detailed itineraries with Google and Outlook calendar sync, reminders, check-in alerts and centralized management for CTMs.

items.title: Reporting, tracking & analytics
items.text: Detailed expense reporting, budget forecasting, cost-saving insights and full compliance with internal audit standards.

closing.title: Transform your corporate travel experience
closing.text: AirviaTech Enterprise is more than a booking platform — it's a smart management tool that optimizes your company's travel strategy. Enhance employee satisfaction, reduce costs, digitize operations and improve governance.
